The '''dewdrop tree''' was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Swamp/Legends|marshy]] [[Agrilat Region]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Like most [[Plant/Legends|plants]] in the region, the [[Tree/Legends|tree]] was a [[crystal plant]], meaning that it was composed of a mixture of dense, hard [[Silica/Legends|silica]] and organic materials, and therefore had a [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] appearance. Dewdrop trees bore delicious [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] which were the size of a [[Limb/Legends|fist]] and had the appearance of large [[Ruby/Legends|rubies]] and [[Emerald/Legends|emeralds]].<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The dewdrop tree was mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a<ref name="SoF" /> [[2014]]<ref name="Sights">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2014/1/24/set-your-sights-on-corellia|text=Set Your Sights on Corellia|date=2014-01-24}}</ref> sourcebook published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="SoF" />
